column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., admin, uploader, viewer). always exactly one of 'admin', 'uploader', 'viewer'. may be NULL.
Date and time when the user account was created. may be NULL.
Date and time when the user account was last updated. may be NULL.
Date and time of the user's last login. may be NULL.
Status of the user account (e.g., active, suspended, deleted). always exactly one of 'active', 'suspended', 'deleted'. may be NULL.
